name: cenci-watch
description: cenci attention layer for Claude Code and Codex: live status, dispatch, and optional display integrations

statusCommand.title: /cenci-status command
statusCommand.description: Register the read-only /cenci-status command, which shows `cenci status` immediately, even while Claude is working. Needs Claude Code v2.1.287 or later.

nativeMeasurements.title: Native measurements
nativeMeasurements.description: Send Claude Code's own context and rate-limit figures to the cenci daemon after each turn. Off by default; sends no cost; never starts the daemon. Needs Claude Code v2.1.319 or later.
